name: Arizona AIA State Cross Country Championships
where: Phoenix, AZ · Cave Creek Golf Course
headline: Arizona AIA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Highland won the Division I boys title with 57 points over Mountain View Mesa (107), and Red Mountain’s Crew Comish won the race in 15:37.9. Mountain View Mesa won the D-I girls title, 74 to 93 over Highland, with Cassidy Long the winner in 18:38.6. Flagstaff (boys) and Ironwood Ridge (girls) won Division II, ALA-West Foothills (boys) and ALA-Queen Creek (girls) won Division III, and Hopi swept the Division IV team titles.
